ENGINE MECHANICAL - CYLINDER HEAD
REMOVAL
1. REMOVE BATTERY
2. REMOVE ECU BOX (See page EM-74)
3. DRAIN ENGINE COOLANT
4. DISCONNECT ENGINE COOLANT RESERVOIR
5. REMOVE AIR CLEANER ASSEMBLY
6. DISCONNECT ACCELERATOR CABLE
7. REMOVE DRIVE BELT AND ALTERNATOR
(See page CH-7)
8. REMOVE EXHAUST PIPE {See page EM-74)
9. 122-FE:
REMOVE EXHAUST MANIFOLD
(a) Remove the 3 bolts and exhaust manifo!d stay.
(b) Remove the 6 bo!ts and upper heat insulator.
(c) Remove the 5 nuts, exhaust manifold and gasket.
(d) Remove the 3 bolts and lower heat insulator.
